text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel harbored a secret admiration 
for Narita Brian. A stride that unleashed 
an explosion of pure energy... that was 
the ideal way to run.

However, strenuous training was difficult 
for her. In order to get closer to her 
ideal running form, she continued to focus 
primarily on observation.

However, seeing Narita Brian and Hishi 
Amazon charge through the Classics was 
dazzling. Sakura Laurel's impatience only 
continued to mount.

Shaking off her hesitation, she focuses on 
what she can do right now. —Place in the 
top 3 of a GIII or higher race. She'll 
steadily build up her achievements at a 
manageable pace.
